reviews.title: Amazing Value
reviews.comment: Was able to get it at $180 in these tough times, great value at that price. XMP is stable and it hits the speeds its advertised at. Build quality on the heat spreader and casing isn't quite there, the light diffuser straight fell off at some point luckily was able to slot it back on.

reviews.title: RAM good. Cover bad.
reviews.comment: The RAM works great. The only problem I have is with the RGB cover. On one of them, it slid off a bit when installing so I had to man-handle it in order to move it back into position (it wasn't easy to re-align and get back into place). So, from a quality/manufacturing standpoint it's not that great. From an actual functionality (the RAM) standpoint it's fine. Works with ASUS Aura as advertised.
